![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Use optional chaining when accessing `catalog.controlled_package_root` to prevent a TypeError if `catalog` is null or undefined.

```suggestion
  return path.resolve(REPO_ROOT, catalog?.controlled_package_root ?? '');
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Ensure readback or report generation functions are null-safe and use defensive guards, optional chaining, and safe default objects when dereferencing properties from potentially missing or malformed input artifacts, allowing the script to fail-closed gracefully instead of throwing a TypeError.
</details>

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Use optional chaining when calling `catalog.getControlledPackageFile` to prevent a TypeError if `catalog` is null or undefined.

```suggestion
  const packageFile = catalog?.getControlledPackageFile?.(assetId);
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Ensure readback or report generation functions are null-safe and use defensive guards, optional chaining, and safe default objects when dereferencing properties from potentially missing or malformed input artifacts, allowing the script to fail-closed gracefully instead of throwing a TypeError.
</details>

Fixed in f704b66a3: readJsonArtifact now checks file existence, catches read/parse failures, and returns null so the catalog loads as an empty fail-closed index. Added missing and malformed JSON tests.

Fixed in f704b66a3: evaluateMsSourceRevealAccess now validates the catalog shape before dereferencing it and fails closed with ms_source_reveal_unavailable. Added regression coverage for a missing/malformed catalog.

Fixed in f704b66a3: resolveControlledAssetPath now checks that getControlledPackageFile is callable before use and fails closed with ms_source_asset_package_entry_missing for null or malformed catalogs. Covered by the asset-store null-safety test.
Fixed in f704b66a3: resolvePackageRoot now uses null-safe catalog access and continues to honor the MS_SOURCE_REVEAL_PACKAGE_ROOT override. Added asset-store null-safety coverage.

Fixed in f704b66a3: indexBy now normalizes non-array inputs to an empty array, skips non-record entries, skips empty ID keys, and preserves first-writer duplicate behavior. Added focused catalog indexing coverage.

Fixed in f704b66a3: the runtime handler now rejects missing or non-string request methods with 400 invalid_payload before any route logic or asset read. Added regression coverage for null, empty, and non-string-method requests.
